neighbours.label: a capitalised piece glued into a compound by '.', '_', '-' or camel case (Style.RESET, JIRA_API, JPL-Caltech, Hewlett-Packard)
fire: The script reads the GITHUB_API_TOKEN value from the environment.
The photo was taken by a team from MIT-Caltech last year.
My first printer was a Hewlett-Packard model from the nineties.
The result was published in PhysRevLett two years later.
export SLACK_API_URL before starting the bot.
quiet: The script reads the token value from the environment.
The photo was taken by a team from two colleges last year.
My first printer was a second-hand model from the nineties.
The result was published in a physics journal two years later.
export the url of the chat server before starting the bot.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (3.1% of tokens reach 0.1 of max) and gate-closed. Top examples: '.RESET', '_API', '.Pool', '-Cal', 'L' in PhysRevLett, ' Man' in Manoa. Probes: _API 0.75, -Cal 0.84, .RESET 0.55, .Pool 0.61, -Pack 0.67, RevL 0.57; a lower-case identifier 0.22, plain prose 0.03. Near misses keep the compound but in lower case or as separate words.
